title: Family at Marlene Bas Mitzvah, Formal Wear - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length indoor portrait taken on January 27, 1962, commemorating Marlene's Bas Mitzvah (Bat Mitzvah). Three family members are dressed in elegant formal attire for the celebration: a young woman on the left wearing a dark sheath dress with a plush white fur cowl collar, an older matriarch in the center dressed in a tailored mid-century day dress with pearls and a stylish hat, and a gentleman on the right in a dark suit jacket with a pocket square and white tie. The photograph captures mid-20th century American Jewish religious life and family milestones.
